claims: Thalcave's father was the last tribal guide
Thalcave spent his boyhood roaming plains with his father
He was shipped to the Château d'If.
The destination was the Château d'If.
He studied the crack-patterns of his mother's shark-tooth necklace by moonlight.
The crack-patterns were used to divine the outcome of a fight.
Each fight preceded by study of the crack-patterns.
